maps.title: Luke and Acts: Jesus’s ministry and its continuation
maps.locator: Sermon transcript, section “Chiastic Structure of Luke-Acts”, ten labeled units

nodes.label: E′
nodes.title: The risen Jesus and his ascension

nodes.label: C′
nodes.title: The church in Judea and Samaria

nodes.label: A′
nodes.title: Paul before Roman authorities and on the way to Rome

relationships.A: Meyer frames the two volumes with Jesus’s birth under Roman rule and Paul’s encounters with Roman authorities and journey to Rome.
relationships.B: Meyer pairs Jesus’s Galilean ministry with the church’s mission among Gentiles.
relationships.C: Meyer pairs Jesus’s movement through Samaria and Judea with the church’s activity in those regions.
relationships.D: Meyer pairs Jesus’s Jerusalem ministry and suffering with the church’s Jerusalem beginnings.
relationships.E: Meyer places the resurrection and ascension accounts at the paired inner hinge.

maps.note: Published pastoral interpretation, not a peer-reviewed consensus claim. Jason Meyer, Bethlehem Baptist Church, “Jesus, Continued”, November1,2020. All ten published source units retained; titles and explanations paraphrased by ChiFold. No unique singleton center is specified: the E/E′ hinge joins Luke24 with Acts1. This proposal is independent of Wolfe’s different Luke–Acts boundaries; do not merge them.
